cart.title: Your cart
cart.saved_body: We have your uploaded image and will print from the mockup you created. Checkout may still show the stock product photo — that does not affect your print.
cart.personalised_label: Personalised — we’ll print from your mockup

products.lead: Upload your photo as a JPG or PNG. We’ll mock up your design and confirm it with you before we dispatch.
products.upload_confirm: We’ll mock up your design and confirm it with you before we dispatch — we won’t print the stock product photo.
products.upload_type: Please upload a JPG or PNG.
products.file_too_large: That file is too large. Please use a photo under 15 MB.
products.file_attached: __FILENAME__ attached. We’ll mock up and confirm before dispatch.

contact.lead: Questions about an order, a print, or delivery? Use the form or the chat button — we’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
contact.aside_body: Include your order number if you have one — it helps us find your print faster.
contact.chat_note: Prefer to chat? Use the chat button in the corner of the page.
contact.name: Name
contact.success: Thanks — we’ve received your message and will get back to you.

delivery.title: Printed locally
delivery.local_print: Printed in {{ country }}. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.printed_in_eu: Printed in the EU. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.nearest_hub: Printed at the nearest Gelato hub. Typical delivery {{ days }}.
delivery.duties: Import duties may apply when an order is produced outside your country.
delivery.returns_eu: EU and UK customers have a statutory cooling-off period for unused goods. Personalised items made to order may have limited return rights — see our refund policy.
delivery.returns_generic: Personalised photo products are made to order. See our refund policy for returns and reprints.
delivery.not_all_products: Not every product is printed in every country. If a local hub cannot produce your item, Gelato ships from the nearest partner.
delivery.heading: Shipping & delivery
delivery.lead: We print on demand with Gelato. In countries with a local print hub, your order is usually produced nearby for faster delivery.
delivery.rates: Shipping is calculated at checkout for your country, based on size and destination.

chooser.fallback: Open the canvas product to choose size and personalise.
chooser.thickness_help: Slim for a modern flush look, thick for a gallery wrap.
chooser.orientation_help: Portrait, landscape, or square — all options shown.
chooser.size_hint: All matching sizes for your selection
chooser.cta_note: Next: personalise with your photo on the product page.

collection.mugs_lead: Ceramic, enamel, porcelain, magic and travel mugs — pick a style, then personalise with your photo.
collection.phone_cases_lead: Flexi, slim, clear, bio and tough cases for Apple and Samsung — pick a style and model, then personalise.
collection.totes_lead: Classic and premium personalised totes — pick a colour, then add your photo or design.
collection.wall_art_lead: Canvas, framed prints, metal, acrylic, posters and more — pick a product type to personalise.
collection.home_gifts_lead: Personalised mugs, bottles, phone cases, tote bags, stickers, tattoos and more — everyday keepsakes they’ll actually use.
collection.posters_lead: Pick a paper finish. Next you’ll choose size and personalise with your photo.
collection.framed_prints_lead: Wooden or metal frames — pick a finish, then choose size, colour and assembly where available.
collection.aluminum_lead: Sleek aluminium panels — choose a finish, then orientation and size.
collection.foam_lead: Lightweight foam board — portrait, landscape or square, with optional edge colour.

product_page.about_fine_art_framed: About this fine art framed print
product_page.customise_body: Use Personalize design to upload your photo, preview on a live mockup, then add to cart. We print and ship to your door.
product_page.wrap_body_cm: Choose a modern slim edge (~2 cm) or a deeper gallery wrap (~4 cm) for every size.
product_page.wrap_body_in: Choose a modern slim edge (~0.8 in) or a deeper gallery wrap (~1.6 in) for every size.
product_page.sizes_body: Portrait, landscape and square options across {{ count }} sizes — pick what fits your wall.
product_page.tray_body: Wood, dark wood or black tray frames that give your canvas a clean gallery finish.
product_page.wood_frame_body: White, wood, dark wood or black wooden frames — metal framed prints coming soon as a separate range.
product_page.frame_colours_body: White, wood, dark wood or black — match your room and let the print take centre stage.
product_page.paper_body: This finish is selected on the posters page — more paper options coming soon as separate products.
product_page.personalize_hint: Use Personalize design to upload your photo and see the live mockup, then add to cart.
product_page.pdp_lead_canvas: Your photo prints on cotton-poly canvas, stretched over FSC wood, then wraps the edge — slim (~2 cm) or thick (~4 cm). Hanging kit in the box.
product_page.pdp_lead_canvas_in: Your photo prints on cotton-poly canvas, stretched over FSC wood, then wraps the edge — slim (~0.8 in) or thick (~1.6 in). Hanging kit in the box.
product_page.pdp_lead_framed_canvas: Gallery-wrapped canvas set in a wood tray frame, in wood, dark wood or black. Ready to hang, in portrait, landscape and square.
product_page.pdp_lead_brushed: A frameless aluminium panel with a brushed metallic grain. About 3 mm thick, with magnetic mounts included.
product_page.pdp_lead_aluminum: A sleek frameless metal print. About 3 mm thick, magnetic mounts included, ready to hang.
product_page.pdp_lead_hanger: Matte poster held in magnetic wood rails, with cord included — hang it, take it down, swap the print.
product_page.pdp_lead_wood: Printed on birch plywood so the grain shows through the ink. 10–15 mm thick and ready to hang.
product_page.pdp_lead_semi_glossy: A classic 170 gsm semi-gloss sheet. Frame it yourself — portrait, landscape and square sizes.
product_page.pdp_lead_matte: Fully matte 200 gsm paper with no sheen. A frameless sheet to frame yourself.
product_page.pdp_lead_fine_art: Archival 200 gsm matte, printed 12-colour giclée. A gallery sheet to frame yourself.
product_page.pdp_lead_classic_framed: Classic semi-gloss paper in a slim wood frame, four colours, sawtooth hanger included.
product_page.pdp_lead_premium_framed: Premium semi-gloss paper in a slim wood frame, four colours, ready to hang.
product_page.pdp_lead_fine_art_framed: Archival giclée in a slim wood frame. Gallery paper, four frame colours, sawtooth hanger included.
product_page.pdp_lead_metal_framed: Semi-gloss paper in a slim metal frame. Ready to hang, in a wide range of sizes.
product_page.pdp_lead_acrylic: Your photo face-mounted on clear acrylic, 3–5 mm, with standoffs so it floats off the wall.
product_page.pdp_lead_foam: A lightweight foam-board print, 5–10 mm thick — easy to hang, easy to gift.
product_page.story_frame_body: Your canvas sits inside a slim tray frame with a 12 mm gap, so the print appears to float. Choose black, natural wood or dark wood for a clean gallery finish.
product_page.story_frame_alt: Black tray-frame canvas, shown from the side to highlight the floating gap
product_page.story_sizes_body: Thirteen sizes in portrait, landscape and square — from 20×25 cm (8×10″) up to 60×90 cm (24×36″). Pick what fits the space, then personalise with your photo.
product_page.story_sizes_alt: Three framed canvases in different sizes arranged on a sideboard
product_page.story_colours_body: Natural wood, dark wood and matte black. Match the room and let the photo take centre stage.
product_page.story_colours_alt: Close-up of natural wood, dark wood and black floating frames
product_page.story_texture_title: Canvas you can see and feel
product_page.story_texture_body: Cotton-polyester blend on FSC stretcher bars, printed for lasting colour. A hanging kit is included — thickness is 42 mm in North America and 32 mm in Europe.
product_page.story_texture_alt: Magnified corner of a black floating frame showing canvas weave
product_page.similar_title: More ways to print your photo
product_page.similar_intro: Same picture, a different finish — frames, metal, posters and more.
product_page.canvas_story_wrap_body_cm: Your photo prints onto real canvas, then wraps around the edge. Choose a modern slim wrap (~2 cm) or a deeper gallery wrap (~4 cm) for every size.
product_page.canvas_story_wrap_body_in: Your photo prints onto real canvas, then wraps around the edge. Choose a modern slim wrap (~0.8 in) or a deeper gallery wrap (~1.6 in) for every size.
product_page.canvas_story_wrap_alt: Angled canvas print showing gallery-wrap depth and canvas texture
product_page.canvas_story_texture_title: Canvas you can see and feel
product_page.canvas_story_texture_body: Cotton-polyester blend stretched over FSC wood bars, printed for lasting colour. The weave is part of the finish — not a flat poster.
product_page.canvas_story_texture_alt: Magnified canvas corner showing the woven texture and wrapped edge
product_page.canvas_story_corner_body: Canvas is pulled tight over the stretcher and folded clean at the corners, so it hangs like a gallery piece with no extra frame.
product_page.canvas_story_corner_alt: Close-up of a stretched canvas corner showing the gallery wrap fold
product_page.canvas_story_hanging_body: Stapled on the back, with sawtooth hangers, hooks, screws and stretcher keys in the box. Personalise with your photo, then hang it.
product_page.canvas_story_hanging_alt: Back of a stretched canvas with hanging hardware, screws and stretcher keys
product_page.aluminum_story_panel_body: Your photo prints onto a rigid aluminium composite panel — no frame, no glass. A slim modern edge that sits close to the wall.
product_page.aluminum_story_panel_alt: Angled aluminium print on a black background showing the thin panel edge
product_page.aluminum_story_edge_body: A sleek white-core sandwich around 3 mm thick, with vivid colour on a smooth metal face. Built to last indoors.
product_page.aluminum_story_edge_body_brushed: A fine horizontal brush on the metal face catches the light. Around 3 mm thick, with a dark core between two metal skins.
product_page.aluminum_story_edge_alt: Magnified corner of a metal print showing the thin sandwich edge and surface grain
product_page.aluminum_story_lifestyle_title: A gallery look without the frame
product_page.aluminum_story_lifestyle_body: Leans or hangs as a clean panel. Personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.aluminum_story_lifestyle_alt: Brushed metal print leaning against a wall in a living space
product_page.aluminum_story_hanging_body: Float the panel off the wall with magnetic discs, screws and wall plugs in the box. No extra hardware to buy.
product_page.aluminum_story_hanging_alt: Corner of a metallic print with magnetic hanging discs, screws and wall plugs
product_page.brushed_story_stack_body: A rigid aluminium sandwich around 3 mm thick — metal skins, dark core, sharp square corners. No frame, no glass. Portraits, couples and stills all sit on that brushed face.
product_page.brushed_story_stack_alt: Three brushed aluminium prints stacked on a white surface showing the thin sandwich edge
product_page.brushed_story_edge_body: A fine horizontal brush catches the light across the silver face. The magnified corner shows the dark core between two metal skins — slim, rigid and built to last indoors.
product_page.brushed_story_edge_alt: Magnified corner of a brushed aluminium print showing surface grain and sandwich edge
product_page.brushed_story_lean_title: A gallery look without the frame
product_page.brushed_story_lean_body: The grain becomes part of the picture. Lean it or hang it as a clean panel — personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.brushed_story_lean_alt: Brushed aluminium print leaning against a wall on a wooden floor
product_page.brushed_story_room_body: Square beside portrait, both with the same metallic grain. Hang a pair above a console or keep it as a single statement piece.
product_page.brushed_story_room_alt: Two brushed aluminium prints on a wall above a console table
product_page.brushed_story_hanging_body: Float the panel off the wall with magnetic discs, screws and wall plugs in the box. No extra hardware to buy.
product_page.brushed_story_hanging_alt: Corner of a brushed metallic print with magnetic hanging discs, screws and wall plugs
product_page.hanger_story_product_title: Wood bars, matte paper, ready to hang
product_page.hanger_story_product_body: Your photo prints on premium matte paper, held top and bottom by magnetic wooden rails. A cord on the top bar — hang from a single pin, no frame needed.
product_page.hanger_story_product_alt: Matte poster with wooden hangers and hanging cord, shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.hanger_story_wood_body: Two matching wooden bars sandwich the poster. Light oak grain, a slim leather-look cord, and magnets that grip the paper without clips or tape. Pick hanger colour in the options above.
product_page.hanger_story_wood_alt: Close-up of magnetic wooden hanger bars holding textured white paper, with a hanging cord
product_page.hanger_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a fine pebbled grain and no glare. Colours sit soft and gallery-flat — made for indoor walls.
product_page.hanger_story_paper_alt: Close-up of a premium matte paper poster corner showing texture and 200 gsm weight
product_page.hanger_story_lifestyle_body: Hangs as a clean vertical panel above a console or sofa. Personalise with your photo, pick orientation, size and hanger colour, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.hanger_story_lifestyle_alt: Matte poster with wooden hangers above a console table in a bright room
product_page.hanger_story_pair_body: The same wooden hangers work as a set. Side by side on a white wall — light, Scandi and easy to swap when you change the print.
product_page.hanger_story_pair_alt: Two matte posters with wooden hangers hung side by side above a wooden bench
product_page.wood_story_panel_body: The image sits on a thick birch plywood board — no frame, no glass. Grain shows through the lighter areas, so every print has a natural, one-of-a-kind look.
product_page.wood_story_panel_alt: Wood print of a desert landscape showing the layered plywood edge
product_page.wood_story_layers_title: Layered plywood, grain in the ink
product_page.wood_story_layers_body: Around 10–15 mm of stacked birch plies. The magnified corner shows a clean cut and the wood grain under the colour — sturdy, warp-resistant and made for indoor walls.
product_page.wood_story_layers_alt: Close-up of a wood print corner with a magnified view of the layered plywood edge
product_page.wood_story_corner_body: Six to eight visible plies, light and medium wood in stripes. A solid, gallery-style edge that needs no extra frame.
product_page.wood_story_corner_alt: Angled corner of a wood print showing the multi-layer plywood construction
product_page.wood_story_pair_title: Hang a pair, keep the grain
product_page.wood_story_pair_body: Two boards side by side, same thickness and the same warm timber showing through. Personalise with your photos, pick orientation and size, and they sit as a set.
product_page.wood_story_pair_alt: Two wood prints hung above a wooden desk in a bright room
product_page.wood_story_room_body: Square beside landscape, both with the wood grain in the photo. A natural finish that sits easily in a bedroom, nursery or living space.
product_page.wood_story_room_alt: Two wood prints on a bedroom wall above a wooden bed, with a child standing nearby
product_page.poster_story_look_body: A slim, frameless print with a soft semi-gloss sheen. Colours stay vivid, edges stay sharp — hang it, frame it, or pin it as a clean sheet of art.
product_page.poster_story_look_alt: Classic semi-glossy paper poster shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.poster_story_paper_body: Mid-weight 170 gsm / 65 lb stock with a fine grain and a low sheen — not matte, not high-gloss. Colours sit bright without a harsh mirror shine.
product_page.poster_story_paper_alt: Close-up of a classic semi-glossy paper poster corner showing texture and 170 gsm weight
product_page.poster_story_finish_body: The everyday gallery finish: saturated colour, a gentle highlight down the sheet, and a smooth face that photographs and rooms well.
product_page.poster_story_finish_alt: Classic semi-glossy paper sample with abstract colour and finish label
product_page.poster_story_gallery_title: One print, or a gallery of four
product_page.poster_story_gallery_body: Personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang a single sheet or frame a set. Same paper, same sheen — they read as a collection.
product_page.poster_story_gallery_alt: Four framed botanical posters in a two-by-two grid on a living-room wall
product_page.matte_poster_story_look_title: Your photo on premium matte paper
product_page.matte_poster_story_look_body: A slim, frameless sheet with a fine pebbled grain and no glare. Soft colour, museum-flat — hang it, frame it, or pin it as a quiet piece of art.
product_page.matte_poster_story_look_alt: Premium matte paper poster shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.matte_poster_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a toothy, non-reflective face. Colours sit soft and gallery-flat — made for indoor walls and wooden frames.
product_page.matte_poster_story_paper_alt: Close-up of a premium matte paper poster corner showing texture and 200 gsm weight
product_page.matte_poster_story_finish_body: Heavier than the classic semi-gloss, with zero shine. The finish painters and photographers pick when they want the paper, not the light, to do the talking.
product_page.matte_poster_story_finish_alt: Premium matte paper sample with abstract colour and finish label
product_page.matte_poster_story_room_title: Frame it, and it sits quietly
product_page.matte_poster_story_room_body: Personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang the sheet or drop it into a thin wood frame. Matte paper does not bounce the room back at you.
product_page.matte_poster_story_room_alt: Framed premium matte poster hanging above a wooden dresser in a bright room
product_page.fine_art_story_look_title: Your photo as a gallery sheet
product_page.fine_art_story_look_body: A heavy, textured fine-art sheet with a generous white margin. No frame, no glass — just archival paper and colour that is meant to last.
product_page.fine_art_story_look_alt: Fine art poster with a 3D abstract sculpture, shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.fine_art_story_border_body: The image sits in a wide white field, like a print from a gallery. Grain shows in the paper — ready to float-mount or drop into a frame.
product_page.fine_art_story_border_alt: Fine art poster with a painterly colour grid and a wide white border
product_page.fine_art_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a fine, fibrous grain. Matte, not glossy — the kind of paper watercolour and giclée prints are made for.
product_page.fine_art_story_paper_alt: Close-up of a fine art poster corner showing paper texture and 200 gsm weight
product_page.fine_art_story_giclee_body: Standard inkjet uses four inks. Fine art giclée uses twelve — smoother gradients, deeper blues, richer oranges. The difference is in the colour, not just the paper.
product_page.fine_art_story_giclee_alt: Side-by-side comparison of 4-colour inkjet and 12-colour fine art giclée
product_page.fine_art_story_detail_body: Soft, toothy paper that drinks pigment without glare. Personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang or frame it as a true print.
product_page.fine_art_story_detail_alt: Angled close-up of a fine art poster showing fibrous paper and 200 gsm label
product_page.classic_framed_story_look_body: Your photo prints on classic semi-glossy paper, then sits in a thin wooden frame. A modern profile, a soft sheen, and a clean gallery look — no extra framing to buy.
product_page.classic_framed_story_look_alt: Classic semi-glossy poster in a thin black wooden frame, shown at an angle
product_page.classic_framed_story_colours_title: White, wood, dark wood or black
product_page.classic_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print centre stage. Pick frame colour in the options above.
product_page.classic_framed_story_colours_alt: Four stacked wooden frame corners in white, natural wood, dark wood and black
product_page.classic_framed_story_hanging_body: Fibreboard backing, flexi-points holding the print, and a sawtooth hanger already fitted. One nail, and it is on the wall.
product_page.classic_framed_story_hanging_alt: Back corner of a black wooden frame showing sawtooth hanger and backing board
product_page.classic_framed_story_room_body: Personalise with your photo, pick orientation, size and frame colour. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle above a chair or side table.
product_page.classic_framed_story_room_alt: Framed semi-glossy poster hanging on a grey wall above a wooden side table
product_page.classic_framed_story_gallery_body: The same thin wood frame in portrait and landscape. Cluster a set above a credenza — one paper, one sheen, they read as a collection.
product_page.classic_framed_story_gallery_alt: Six white wooden framed posters arranged as a gallery wall above a wooden cabinet
product_page.classic_framed_story_bedroom_body: Natural wood frames and a wide white mat. Five prints, one wall — pick sizes that fit the space and the same finish throughout.
product_page.classic_framed_story_bedroom_alt: Five natural-wood framed posters in a gallery arrangement above a bed
product_page.premium_framed_story_look_body: Your photo prints on premium semi-glossy paper, then sits in a thin wooden frame. A richer sheen than classic stock, a modern profile, and a gallery look — no extra framing to buy.
product_page.premium_framed_story_look_alt: Premium semi-glossy print in a thin black wooden frame, shown at an angle
product_page.premium_framed_story_colours_title: White, wood, dark wood or black
product_page.premium_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print centre stage. Pick frame colour in the options above.
product_page.premium_framed_story_colours_alt: Four stacked wooden frame corners in white, natural wood, dark wood and black
product_page.premium_framed_story_hanging_body: Fibreboard backing, flexi-points holding the print, and a sawtooth hanger already fitted. One nail, and it is on the wall.
product_page.premium_framed_story_hanging_alt: Back corner of a black wooden frame showing sawtooth hanger and backing board
product_page.premium_framed_story_room_body: Personalise with your photo, pick orientation, size and frame colour. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle above a chair or coffee table.
product_page.premium_framed_story_room_alt: Premium framed print hanging on a light wall above a wooden coffee table
product_page.premium_framed_story_gallery_body: The same thin wood frame in portrait and landscape. Cluster a set above a credenza — one paper, one sheen, they read as a collection.
product_page.premium_framed_story_gallery_alt: Six white wooden framed prints arranged as a gallery wall above a wooden cabinet
product_page.premium_framed_story_bedroom_body: Natural wood frames and a wide white mat. Five prints, one wall — pick sizes that fit the space and the same finish throughout.
product_page.premium_framed_story_bedroom_alt: Five natural-wood framed prints in a gallery arrangement above a bed
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_look_title: Fine art paper, slim wood frame
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_look_body: Your photo prints as a giclée on archival paper, then sits in a thin wooden frame behind glass. Gallery colour, a museum sheet, ready to hang.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_look_alt: Fine art poster in a thin black wooden frame, shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_edge_title: Mitered wood, grain in the paper
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_edge_body: A clean 45-degree joint and a shallow, modern profile. The magnified corner shows the fibrous fine-art sheet — not glossy poster stock.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_edge_alt: Magnified corner of a fine art framed poster showing paper texture and mitered black frame
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a toothy, fibrous grain. Matte, made for giclée — the same fine art sheet as the unframed print, now behind glass.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_paper_alt: Close-up of a fine art poster corner showing paper texture and 200 gsm weight
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_colours_title: White, wood, dark wood or black
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print centre stage. Pick frame colour in the options above.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_colours_alt: Four stacked wooden frame corners in white, natural wood, dark wood and black
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_hanging_body: Fibreboard backing, flexi-points holding the print, and a sawtooth hanger already fitted. One nail, and it is on the wall.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_hanging_alt: Back corner of a black wooden frame showing sawtooth hanger and backing board
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_room_title: Hang a pair, keep the paper
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_room_body: Personalise with your photos, pick orientation, size and frame colour. Two prints side by side — the same fine art sheet, the same slim wood.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_room_alt: Two fine art framed posters hung above a wooden console table
product_page.metal_framed_story_look_body: Your photo prints on classic semi-glossy paper, then sits in a thin black metal frame behind glass. A modern profile, a soft sheen, and a gallery look — no extra framing to buy.
product_page.metal_framed_story_look_alt: Classic semi-glossy poster in a thin black metal frame, shown at an angle
product_page.metal_framed_story_edge_body: Extruded metal with a satin black finish and a clean 45-degree joint. Slim, sharp and lighter than a wooden frame of the same size.
product_page.metal_framed_story_edge_alt: Close-up of a black metal frame corner showing the mitered join and paper inside
product_page.metal_framed_story_hanging_title: Clips and a hanging plate on the back
product_page.metal_framed_story_hanging_body: Fibreboard backing held by rotating metal clips, plus a slotted hanging plate. One hook or nail, and it is on the wall.
product_page.metal_framed_story_hanging_alt: Back corner of a black metal frame showing backing board, clips and hanging plate
product_page.metal_framed_story_wall_body: Personalise with your photo, pick orientation and size. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle on a white wall — the black metal line is the only border.
product_page.metal_framed_story_wall_alt: Black metal framed poster hanging on a white wall above a woven bench
product_page.metal_framed_story_room_body: The same slim metal works beside a chair or a lamp. Semi-gloss paper keeps colour bright without a harsh mirror shine.
product_page.metal_framed_story_room_alt: Metal framed poster on a textured wall beside a yellow armchair
product_page.metal_framed_story_shelf_body: Light enough to sit on a cabinet, sharp enough to hang. One finish, one frame — swap the photo whenever you like.
product_page.metal_framed_story_shelf_alt: Metal framed poster standing on a wooden shelf beside a lamp
product_page.acrylic_story_look_body: The image sits under a thick, glossy acrylic sheet — no frame, no glass. Four metal standoffs float it off the wall so light can catch the polished edge.
product_page.acrylic_story_look_alt: Acrylic print with metal corner standoffs, shown at an angle on a black background
product_page.acrylic_story_edge_body: Around 3–5 mm of clear acrylic with a high-gloss surface. The magnified corner shows the depth of the sheet and the brushed-metal standoff cap.
product_page.acrylic_story_edge_alt: Magnified corner of an acrylic print showing thickness and a metal standoff
product_page.acrylic_story_stack_body: Colour sits behind the acrylic so it looks deeper and brighter. Portraits, landscapes and stills all get that gallery-glass finish without a frame.
product_page.acrylic_story_stack_alt: Four overlapping acrylic print corners showing photos, thickness and standoffs
product_page.acrylic_story_corner_body: A square, see-through edge and a silver standoff in each corner. The print is drilled and ready — no extra frame to buy.
product_page.acrylic_story_corner_alt: Close-up of an acrylic print corner showing polished edge and metal standoff
product_page.acrylic_story_hanging_body: Four metal standoffs, wall screws, plugs and an Allen key. Float the panel off the wall — no extra hardware to buy.
product_page.acrylic_story_hanging_alt: Acrylic print corner with standoffs, screws, wall plugs and Allen key
product_page.foam_story_board_title: Light foam, a sharp black edge
product_page.foam_story_board_body: Your photo prints on a rigid foam board around 5–10 mm thick. White face, black core, square corners — no frame, no glass, easy to hang or lean.
product_page.foam_story_board_alt: White foam board with a black edge and a magnified corner showing the foam core
product_page.foam_story_close_title: Portraits sit on a clean, matte face
product_page.foam_story_close_body: A slightly textured, non-reflective surface. White or black foam edge, depending on the board. Close-ups of kids, couples and stills all stay sharp.
product_page.foam_story_close_alt: Two foam prints close up, one of a boy in overalls and one of a smiling girl
product_page.foam_story_pair_title: Hang a pair, portrait or square
product_page.foam_story_pair_body: Two boards side by side above a table. Personalise with your photos, pick portrait, square or landscape on the matching product page, and they sit as a set.
product_page.foam_story_pair_alt: Two portrait foam prints on a white wall above a dining table
product_page.foam_story_hold_title: Light enough to hold, big enough for a wall
product_page.foam_story_hold_body: Landscape boards are wide and still light. Personalise with your photo, pick the size, then hang it or hold it up to see how it fills the space.
product_page.foam_story_hold_alt: A person holding a landscape foam print of a man kissing a toddler against a white wall
